function Initialize-AsyncEngine {
    if ($script:AsyncEngineReady) { return }
    # Une nouvelle initialisation apres authentification reussie rearme le canal AD.
    $script:DirectoryCredentialFaulted = $false
    $script:DirectoryCredentialFaultMessage = ""
    $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    Write-StartupTrace -Stage "Moteur multithread" -Status "START"
    try {
        $registry = Get-DomeniaWorkerOperationHashes
        if ($registry.Count -ne 54) { throw "Registre worker incomplet : $($registry.Count)/54 operation(s)." }
        foreach ($operationId in $registry.Keys) {
            if ([string]$registry[$operationId] -notmatch '^[A-F0-9]{64}$') { throw "Hash worker invalide pour $operationId." }
        }
        [void](Assert-DomeniaWorkerOperationCode -OperationId "EngineSelfTest" -Code (Get-DomeniaWorkerEngineSelfTestCode))
        $script:AsyncEngineReady = $true
        $script:AsyncEngineClosing = $false

        $timer = New-Object System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer
        $timer.Interval = [System.TimeSpan]::FromMilliseconds([Math]::Max(100,[int](Get-CfgValue "Async" "PollIntervalMs" 250)))
        $timer.Add_Tick({
            try { Complete-UiTasks }
            catch {
                try { Write-AppLog "Moteur asynchrone : $($_.Exception.ToString())" "ERROR" } catch { }
                try { Set-Status "Erreur interne du moteur asynchrone : $($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" } catch { }
            }
        })
        $script:AsyncTimer = $timer
        $script:AsyncTimer.Start()
        $sw.Stop()
        Write-StartupTrace -Stage "Moteur multithread" -Status "OK" -DurationMs $sw.ElapsedMilliseconds -Detail "Moteur ferme pret ; 54 operations hash-pinnees, un runspace MTA dedie par tache."
    }
    catch {
        $sw.Stop()
        Write-StartupTrace -Stage "Moteur multithread" -Status "ERROR" -Detail $_.Exception.ToString() -DurationMs $sw.ElapsedMilliseconds
        $script:AsyncEngineReady = $false
        throw
    }
}
